title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, separate barrel-arbor winding and drum release, stage-resolved train losses, dynamic load feedback, finite polygon escapement work, an integrated balance oscillator, and a reconciled closed-loop normalized work ledger.

facts.Current pass: M6a–M6e barrel torque ↔ stage-resolved train load → polygon work → balance θ/ω → release, with normalized work/loss closure
